# A second review of the test reach, each file a shape it found answered
# wrongly somewhere. On a recursive instance an event fired from a test runs
# its call sites' handlers: one forwarding what it was handed (chain), one
# that binds a parameter it never reads (unused), one that returns from the
# middle (ret). A component built at run time names a node of its own under
# an id the page also writes (same, slotrec). An out-of-block method a test
# calls through the node it is handed writes the var the node's call site
# bound (method). A local holding a ref read after something may have moved
# what it names is refused on a compiled target (alias, list), where it would
# read the ref live and the interpreter keeps the value it took. A recursion
# binding its own two-way prop to its next level carries one write-back per
# level, and its levels each name a node `next` that a spliced copy of the
# top level names too (twoway); bubbletea refuses the focus stops in it. A
# forwarded parameter a handler never reads still has its argument evaluated
# (unused2), and a handler's own locals and loop variables are its own each
# time a test fires it (ret2). A ref a local holds is read before the
# statement reading it moves anything (fp), and a loop that moves anything has
# moved it for the whole body (alias3). A closure stored in a var and called
# from a later handler writes the state the program holds (lat). A method
# written outside its component's block writes the cell of a prop its call
# site left unbound (method2). A handler returning from inside a closure that
# also catches a raise compiles on Kotlin (kret). An unread argument that is
# no call is evaluated for what it calls, decided or not (unused3; android
# runs only the undecided half, since a test's call of its component's method
# under a `&&` or a ternary does not compile there on main either). Each branch
# of an `if`, and a for-else's else, starts from the state before it
# (branches), and an expression moves what it moves before the operands after
# it read it (order). An unread argument of a type Go cannot compare is read
# into `_` (unused4), and a ternary's branches each start from the state
# before them (ternary); neither runs on android, where #270 keeps a test's
# call of its component's method under a literal or a ternary from compiling.
# A condition is read again after a body that moves (condloop), and a
# function literal that moves has moved from where it is written (literal), and a
# loop with no head whose body moves asks no condition again (headless).

sngl test --platform=none chain.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html chain.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- chain.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                hit()
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(7)
        t.assert(c.last == 7)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- unused.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                hit(1)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(7)
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main

-- ret.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                if n > 5 {
                    return
                }
                hit(n)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(7)
        t.assert(c.last == -1)
        c.s.next.hit(3)
        t.assert(c.last == 3)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- same.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, label string) node {
    vbox {
        text #t(value="{label}{depth}")
        if depth < 1 {
            step(depth=depth + 1, label=label)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var name = "a"
    var d = 0
    vbox {
        text #t(value="main")
        button #go(text="go", @click {
            name = "b"
        })
        step(depth=d, label=name)
    }
}

func testSame(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.t.value == "main")
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.t.value == "main")
}

window {
    main
}
-- method.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component box(:count int) node {
    text #shown(value="{count}")
}

func box.twice(b box) int {
    return b.count * 2
}

func box.reset(b box) {
    b.count = 0
}

component main node {
    var total = 3
    vbox {
        box #b(:count=total)
        button #go(text="r", @click {
            b.reset()
        })
    }
}

func testOutOfBlock(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.b.twice() == 6)
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.total == 0)
    c.total = 2
    c.b.reset()
    t.assert(c.total == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- slotrec.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component card(depth int, content ...component node) node {
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        text #t(value="{depth}:{hits}")
        content
        if depth < 1 {
            card #inner(depth=depth + 1) {
                button #b(text="x", @click {
                    hits = hits + 1
                })
            }
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        card #c0(depth=0) {
            text(value="top")
        }
    }
}

func testSlot(t Test, c main) {
    if c.c0.b != null {
        c.c0.b.click()
        t.assert(c.c0.hits == 1)

        t.assert(c.c0.t.value == "0:1")
    }
    if c.c0.inner != null {
        t.assert(c.c0.inner.hits == 0)
        t.assert(c.c0.inner.depth == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- twoway.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, :count int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        button #b(text="{depth}:{count}", @click {
            count = count + 1
        })
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, :count=count)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var total = 0
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, :count=total)
    }
}

func testTwoWay(t Test, c main) {
    c.s.b.click()
    t.assert(c.total == 1)
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.b.click()
        t.assert(c.s.count == 2)
        t.assert(c.total == 2)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- alias.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var shown = false
    vbox {
        button #go(text="go", @click {
            shown = !shown
        })
        if shown {
            text #t(value="x")
        }
    }
}

func testAlias(t Test, c main) {
    var v = c.t
    t.assert(v == null)
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.t != null)
    t.assert(v == null)
}

window {
    main
}
-- list.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var names list[string] = ["x", "y", "z"]
    vbox {
        button #go(text="go", @click {
            names = ["x"]
        })
        for var n = names {
            text #t(value=n)
        }
    }
}

func testList(t Test, c main) {
    var ts = c.t
    t.assert(ts.length() == 3)
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.t.length() == 1)
    t.assert(ts.length() == 3)
}

window {
    main
}
-- unused2.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                hit(1)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    var count = 0
    func bump() int {
        count = count + 1
        return count
    }
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(c.bump())
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
        t.assert(c.count == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main
}

-- ret2.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                var xs list[int] = [1, 2, 3]
                for var x = xs {
                    for var y = xs {
                        if x + y == n {
                            hit(x * 10 + y)
                            return
                        }
                    }
                }
                hit(0)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    var count = 0
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
            count = count + 1
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(4)
        t.assert(c.last == 13)
        t.assert(c.count == 1)
        c.s.next.hit(99)
        t.assert(c.last == 0)
        t.assert(c.count == 2)
        c.s.next.hit(4)
        t.assert(c.count == 3)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
-- lat.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component outer(@named(s int)) node {
    var later func() = func() {}
    vbox {
        button #a(text="a", @click {
            later = func() {
                named(3)
            }
        })
        button #l(text="l", @click {
            later()
        })
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = 0
    vbox {
        outer #o(@named(s) {
            last = last + s
        })
    }
}

func testLat(t Test, c main) {
    c.o.a.click()
    c.o.l.click()
    t.assert(c.last == 3)
}

window {
    main
}
-- method2.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component box(:count int = 3) node {
    text #shown(value="{count}")
}

func box.twice(b box) int {
    return b.count * 2
}

func box.reset(b box) {
    b.count = 0
}

func box.bump(b box) {
    b.count = b.count + 5
}

component main node {
    vbox {
        box #b()
        button #go(text="r", @click {
            b.reset()
        })
    }
}

func testA(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.bump()
    t.assert(c.b.count == 8)
}

func testB(t Test, c main) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.b.count == 0)
}

func testC(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.b.twice() == 6)
}

window {
    main
}
-- kret.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func risky(x int) {
    if x > 5 {
        error.raise("big", "big")
    }
}

component main node {
    var n = 0
    var f func(int) = func(x int) {}
    vbox {
        button #b(text="b", @click {
            f = func(x int) {
                n = 0
                for var i = [1, 2, 3] {
                    if i == x {
                        n = i
                        return
                    }
                }
                var g = func(y int) int {
                    if y > 1 {
                        return y
                    }
                    return 0
                }
                risky(x, @error(e) {
                    n = -1
                    return
                })
                if n >= 0 {
                    n = g(x)
                }
            }
            f(2)
        })
        button #c(text="c", @click {
            f(9)
        })
        button #d(text="d", @click {
            f(4)
        })
    }
}

func testKt(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 2)
    c.c.click()
    t.assert(c.n < 0)
    c.d.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 4)
}

window {
    main
}
-- unused3.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(n int)) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(n) {
                hit(1)
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    var count = 0
    func bump() int {
        count = count + 1
        return count
    }
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(n) {
            last = n
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit(c.bump() + 1)
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
        t.assert(c.count == 1)
    }
}

func testDecided(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit([c.bump() > 0 && c.bump() > 0].length())
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
        t.assert(c.count == 2)
    }
}

window {
    main
}

-- unused4.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component step(depth int, @hit(xs list[int])) node {
    vbox {
        text #b(value="{depth}")
        if depth < 2 {
            step #next(depth=depth + 1, @hit(xs) {
                hit([1])
            })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var last = -1
    var count = 0
    func bump() int {
        count = count + 1
        return count
    }
    vbox {
        step #s(depth=0, @hit(xs) {
            last = xs.length()
        })
    }
}

func testChain(t Test, c main) {
    if c.s.next != null {
        c.s.next.hit([c.bump()].filter(func(x int) => x > 0))
        t.assert(c.last == 1)
        t.assert(c.count == 1)
    }
}

window {
    main
}

-- headless.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component box() {
    var shown = true
    if shown {
        ui.text #lbl(value="hi")
    }
    ui.button #b(text="t", @click { shown = !shown })
}

func testLoop(t test.Test, c box) {
    var v = c.lbl
    t.assert(v != null)
    for {
        c.b.click()
        break
    }
}

ui.window(title="x") {
    box()
}
